fixed.calibration: FR_s0, 128 x 512, CANONICAL-B1 cache, frozen order

conditions.stop50: expert IDs with e % 2 == 0 (30/60 per layer) skip Hessian accumulation for sequence positions >= 64; forward unchanged
conditions.stop75: expert IDs with e % 4 != 3 (45/60 per layer), same

experiment1.mask_rule: fixed by expert ID, independent of quality and exposure; same for gu and down
experiment1.timing: per layer, sequences pre-materialized in RAM; 1 warm-up replay, then REPS=3 interleaved repetitions per condition with cuda synchronize; median + range; forward-only and hooks-without-accumulation conditions isolate forward and hook overhead; a separate CUDA-event run splits accumulation into fp32 conversion / GEMM X^T X / update+storage; end-to-end = replay + 720 GPTQ solves per condition
experiment1.validity: layer outputs bitwise identical across conditions (sha256 of all 128 outputs per layer)

experiment2.statistics: token-normalized trace drift and Frobenius drift of H_B vs H_{B/2}, separately for gu and down; routed-token count n_B; relSE not used (only 1-4 contiguous blocks available, would need extra forwards)

rules.trace: both gu and down trace drift < tau_trace

thresholds.primary: tau = MEDIAN of the pooled calibration-only statistic over (expert, gu/down) at that checkpoint; n_min = median n_B over experts at that checkpoint
thresholds.grid: quantiles {0.25, 0.5, 0.75} of the same calibration-only distributions (exploratory)
thresholds.tuning: no separate tuning split is used; thresholds are distribution quantiles fixed a priori and never chosen from held-out results

experiment2.false_safe: among stopped experts, E_stop > 1.01 E_128 (also reported at 2 %)
experiment2.advantage: a passing rule's mean degradation is below the fixed-budget frontier (linear interpolation of fixed B32/B64/B128 in (work skipped, mean degradation)) at its own skipped work

hard_constraints: held-out quality never used for stopping decisions
